title: Union-State executive relations
quote: Executive power over Concurrent List subjects stays with the states, unless the Constitution or a Parliamentary law expressly gives it to the Centre

boxes.title: Vesting & extent of executive power
head: Article
Level
Provision
rows: ==Vests in the **President**==; directly or via subordinate officers

boxes.title: Position of the President
items: **Art. 52**: there shall be a **President of India**
==**Nominal / constitutional head**== = Head of the State, not of Government
Real executive: **Council of Ministers** under **PM**, responsible to **Lok Sabha**

boxes.title: Concurrent List: who executes?
steps: Exception: **Constitution** or **Parliamentary law** expressly gives Centre power

boxes.title: Entrustment & compliance
head: Article
Direction
Condition
rows: Comply with Union laws; not impede Union executive

boxes.title: Emergencies & executive relations
head: Emergency
Effect
rows: Union directs any state on any matter; ==state govts **not suspended**==
Financial propriety; **Money and Financial Bills** reserved for President

cards.title: Administrators
lines: Lakshadweep; Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

boxes.title: Current relevance
items: Ladakh: **sui generis** elected body; **Art. 371-like** safeguards, not Sixth Schedule
SC (**Apr 2026**): Governor ==bound by Cabinet advice== on remission, **Art. 161**
Criticism: **258(2)** and **365** let Union act without state consent

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: ==**258A** = state entrusting functions to Union== (APPSC-GS 2023); ⚠ not river valley agreements
**Art. 154** vests power in **Governor**, though real power lies with CoM
National Emergency: states **not suspended**; Art. 356: CoM **dismissed**
